name: io.github.richardofortune/cadloop-openscad
title: cadloop OpenSCAD
description: Compile OpenSCAD, read computed values, preview and measure the mesh, without a GUI.

environmentVariables.name: OPENSCAD_WORKSPACE
environmentVariables.description: The only directory this server reads and writes. Defaults to ~/cad.

environmentVariables.name: OPENSCAD_BIN
environmentVariables.description: Path to the openscad binary. Auto-detected from PATH and the usual install locations if unset.

environmentVariables.name: OPENSCAD_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Seconds before a run is killed. Defaults to 300.
